description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Spain Spain nationwide national non-substitutable labour holidays for 2026 result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the remaining national, autonomous-community, Ceuta/Melilla and up to two municipal local holidays require a jurisdiction-specific calendar.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Spain: National Day. | Spain: Ordinary weekday.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-10-12"} | {"date":"2026-10-13"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/spain-national-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/spain-national-working-day.md
name: check_es_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Spain nationwide national non-substitutable labour holidays for 2026

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Only national non-substitutable holidays from the BOE calendar are included; autonomous-community and local holidays are not inserted.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: Autonomous-community substitution choices and local compensatory arrangements are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Spain Working Day
